<!-- pr-reviewer: 5eb764a10ea90d536408733a2ba240128932d41c -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (slice 1 of #1473 only; the UI row and viewport pick stay owed there).

**What looks good**
- No exit point set: no code path changes. The digest writes bytes only when set, the DTO key is skipped when absent (old files load as none), and no golden, snapshot or `tests/golden/` file is in the diff.
- With an exit: `exit_at` (contour_start.rs) appends the run along the ring's own cutter-centre polyline after the full loop, so the overlap stays on the already-cut ring at the same offset and depth, and no new crossing is added. It runs per level, so depth passes are covered (pinned per level in `a_picked_exit_cuts_the_whole_ring_then_leaves_at_its_projection`). Leads are replanned with the same `seam_leads` / `extend_leads` legal-region law, so the lead-out cannot leave the machinable side.
- Refused by name, never moved: pick too far from every ring, tabs, control/wear compensation, keep-down level link, overlap set beside it, no lead-out fits, the lead-in lost by the longer walk, lead-out crossing lead-in, open chains (contour_chain.rs), tilted and non-contour kinds (sane.rs), non-finite or out-of-range coordinates. An exit on the seam adds nothing (pinned equal to the path without one). Start and exit set together is covered.
- It rides the existing undoable command (undo restores none, pinned), project round trip, digest stamp and MCP `edit_operation`, with the face-kind refusal pinned over MCP.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new non-test code; code is in `camcraft-motion`; decision file present; the narrow-bore fixtures make the "no lead fits" tests meaningful.

**Results merged with main** (on the self-hosted runner, main df90b031: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43492485735, conclusion success)
- Quick gate: motion suites ok, app suites ok, ui suites ok, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run locally: no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS values are touched. I did not run the new tests against main to see them fail without the code; I read them, and the refusal and exit-foot assertions cannot hold without the new code.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs` is 442 lines (already over 400) and grows by a few lines; a split along the contour-level seam is owed but not blocking.
- Header comment in `contour_start.rs` has one over-long line after the #1473 sentence; tidy when next touched.
- The PR has no `PROCESS_VERSION` or changelog edits, which is correct here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
